description: NaV₃O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.40 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-2.43 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-2.01 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-2.27 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent V atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two V atoms.
